description: Indoor centrepiece. c/n 122-41167; delivered to the USAAF as 44-74627 and transferred to the Philippine Air Force as 73373. Displayed at Basa Air Base 1977-79 marked 3733/001 as 'The Shark of Zimbales'; after restoration it is falsely marked 4823. Warbird Registry and AirHistory both state neither 3733 nor 4823 is its true identity. The Wikipedia P-51 survivor list double-counts this airframe by also listing 44-74627 at Cesar Basa Air Base; there is no P-51 at Basa.

Indoor, suspended from the ceiling. Ex-US Navy Temco TT-1 Pinto rebuilt as the AiResearch/PADC T-610 Cali Super Pinto jet trainer prototype; the museum labels it T-160/T-610 Cali. Wears 44233/233 but the airframe was recorded as 44234 on a 2019 on-site inspection, so the painted number is not the identity. Only a handful were built.
aliases: TT1; 44233; 233; T-610; T610; Super Pinto; Cali
